native_failure.boundary: The terminal native failure excerpt and exact source45 bytes were read. This audit does not impersonate the separate full closed-log readback.

causal_chain.evidence: source45 test initial submission at original lines155–157 and local submit_user_message lines45–50
causal_chain.finding: Initial user input calls start_or_steer_turn with user_message_request only; no Plan thread settings are supplied on that initial turn.
RecoverTurnRequest alone supplies non-default ThreadSettingsOverrides with collaboration_mode Some(Plan), using the configured model, reasoning_effort None and developer_instructions None.

Once the idle/epoch guards pass, is_recovery with any non-default ThreadSettingsOverrides returns precisely InvalidRequest("turn recovery cannot override the interrupted turn settings"). This is unconditional non-default rejection, not equality checking against the old settings.

That settings rejection precedes recovery-candidate consumption and replay application. A valid recovery with default overrides still must validate original context/history, restore persisted start/date/timezone fields, and compare the recovered context and environments exactly.

causal_chain.evidence: closed r16 terminal failure, 0.168s, test line237
causal_chain.finding: The actual failure is the exact settings InvalidRequest returned by the production guard. The earlier request-count/Ready/abort/epoch setup therefore reached the recovery call. This is a distinct remaining fixture error after the source45 header gate; it is not another observed RateLimits/epoch timeout.

evidence_strength: The terminal error string, exact failing source arguments and unique production validation guard directly agree. No new runtime trace or successful candidate execution is claimed.
fixture_change: Construct the same complete CollaborationMode Plan settings once and supply it on the original explicit user TurnInputRequest.with_thread_settings before interruption.
Keep RecoverTurnRequest turn_id, expected_epoch and trace unchanged, with ThreadSettingsOverrides::default so replay resumes the original settings.

Read back the real config_snapshot().collaboration_mode after initial acceptance and after recovery acceptance; compare the whole CollaborationMode to the original expected Plan value, including model, reasoning effort and developer instructions.
why_this_preserves_the_intent: The named test now interrupts a turn that was actually started in Plan mode and requires that exact Plan configuration after recovery. It does not ask recovery to switch modes and does not weaken the production no-override invariant.

readback_owner.delegated_owner: Session::thread_config_snapshot locks the thread-owned session state and returns its current configuration (session/mod.rs1910–1915).
readback_owner.prepared_settings: ThreadSettingsOverrides Some(collaboration_mode) is retained by thread_settings::prepare_update140–161; PreparedTurnInputSettings::apply_started applies settings before creating the new turn context (turn_input.rs146–163).
